title: 1960 AHSME Problem 10
statement:
Given the following six statements:

\((1)\) All women are good drivers.

\((2)\) Some women are good drivers.

\((3)\) No men are good drivers.

\((4)\) All men are bad drivers.

\((5)\) At least one man is a bad driver.

\((6)\) All men are good drivers.

The statement that negates statement \((6)\) is:

solutions.text:
The negation of “All men are good drivers” is “At least one man is not a good driver.” In the terminology of the choices, that is statement \((5),\) “At least one man is a bad driver.”

Therefore, the correct answer is E.
hints: The negation needs only one man who is not a good driver
